source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The privacy-pane initializer awaits DoHConfigController.init before initDoH. Resolver controls then read the resolved providerList and fallbackProviderURI, using uri and UIName fields. This differs from the removed connection dialog’s JSON url/name list and from merely shipping settings dumps. Preserve initialization ordering and the actual record shape when changing provider setup. The outer pane-ready contract and upstream controller implementation are not proved here; no provider UI or network test ran.
title: The DoH UI waits for resolved configuration before populating provider controls
